planets.name: Kepler-8 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-8 with a 3.52-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: Kepler-8 b was found in 2010 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-8. Its orbit and size follow Esteves et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ESTEVES_ET_AL__2015): disc_year 2010, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.52249865, pl_radj 1.416, pl_bmassj 0.59

quotes.title: Kepler-8b
quotes.card: Kepler-8b is the fifth of the first five exoplanets discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft, which aims to discover planets in a region of the sky between the constellations Lyra and Cygnus that transit their host stars.
quotes.introduction: The planet is the hottest of the five.

thermal.source: Esteves et al. 2015, dayside brightness temperature in the Kepler band, assuming no reflected light
thermal.chosen: the paper's value (+100, -200 K; the larger is kept) from an eclipse 26 ± 10 ppm deep; no infrared eclipse is published
